name: Moss
summary: Moss issues unlimited virtual cards and routes purchase requests to the right approver before a commitment is made. Team budgets show live spend for department heads and finance. It charges one platform fee set by the modules chosen, plus a variable fee based on monthly transaction volume, with no per-user fee. It publishes no amounts, so a quote is needed.

facts.text: Moss says virtual cards are unlimited with no per-user fee, and that limits, merchant rules and approvals can be set per card, team or project.
Moss says a purchase request can be required before a commitment is made, and that budgets are live by team, project or cost centre.
The pricing page says the platform fee applies regardless of the number of users and that a variable fee depends on expected monthly transaction volume.
The pricing page offers a free start with Cards or Accounts Payable but does not say what the free option includes.

plans.name: Moss platform
plans.notes: Single platform fee set by the modules and add-ons chosen, plus a variable fee based on monthly transaction volume. No per-user fee. Modules are Corporate Cards, Employee Reimbursements and Accounts Payable

hiddenCosts: Procurement, Advanced Controlling, ERP and AI-powered accounting are add-ons with no published prices.
The pricing page shows no currency or amounts, and Moss is based in Europe, so availability and terms outside its core markets need to be confirmed.
